about: Personal-looking columns that anon or authenticated may read through an open path, each with the reason it is public. Read by scripts/guardrails/no-pii-exposure.mjs. Reviewed 2026-10-19 (SEC3) against live; populations are dated counts. audience omitted = both anon and authenticated.

entries.why: Business contact details and location of organizations (businesses), public by doctrine; tax_id is withheld by column grant (20261020141000).

Officers and 20%+ owners disclosed for an offering (SEC Form C requires this public); 1 row, the issuer's own officer, business address only.
